rationale: Correct the sole IATP record to show its 50/50 InfraBridge and Invenergy ownership. Keep InfraBridge active through legacy GIF II while its signed sale of that 50% interest to ArcLight remains pending, add Invenergy Clean Power as the continuing 50% owner and operator, and keep DigitalBridge only as the parent organization behind the InfraBridge record. No legal closing of the ArcLight acquisition was identified through August 19, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power LLC is a 50/50 joint venture that owns a portfolio of dispatchable power-generation assets across the United States and Canada. InfraBridge holds one half through the legacy AMP Capital Global Infrastructure Fund II strategy, and Invenergy Clean Power holds the other half and continues to operate and manage the portfolio. Public materials report 11 facilities totaling approximately 5.4 GW gross and 3.2 GW net. On March 12, 2026, ArcLight signed an agreement to acquire InfraBridge's 50% interest through disclosed Gray Wolf acquisition vehicles. Regulatory reviews advanced, but no FERC approval, consummation notice or party closing release was identified through August 19, 2026; InfraBridge therefore remains the current legal owner and ArcLight remains a pending incoming buyer.

set.event: Invenergy and AMP Capital announced a 50/50 partnership for the North American thermal-power portfolio, with Invenergy retaining management responsibility.
The 50/50 Invenergy and legacy GIF II investment in Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power commenced; the exact closing day was not publicly disclosed.
ArcLight signed an agreement to acquire InfraBridge's 50% interest, while Invenergy remained the continuing 50% owner and operator.
The parties filed the pending ArcLight acquisition with FERC under docket EC26-76.
U.S. antitrust and Canadian merger reviews advanced, but those clearances did not establish a legal closing of the ArcLight acquisition.
